purpose: Confirmatory zero-shot evaluation of the locked Sleep-EDF checkpoints on a fresh SHHS1 sample never used for preprocessing, inference, model selection, intervention design or analysis.

cohort.selection_method: sort eligible subjects by sha256('shhs-v1-selection|42|subject_id'); identical ranking to the v1 selection
cohort.excluded_ranks: 1-220 (all v1 roles: adaptation 5, validation 15, test 180, reserve 20)

pre_lock_changes.reason: no EDF or Profusion XML listed by NSRR on 2026-10-10
lowest-ranked reserve with both files available

cohort.spare_rule: If a subject fails a technical QC rule before inference, replace it by the next spare in rank order; if spares are exhausted, download ranks 724 onward in order. All replacements are logged before any inference.
technical_qc_exclusion_rules: EEG channel absent or physical unit not uV
EDF and Profusion XML durations disagree beyond the v1 preprocessing tolerance
no scored N1, N2, N3 or REM epoch after label mapping
preprocessing raises an error under configs/shhs_preprocessing_v1.json

preprocessing.changes_from_v1: none; same resampling, label mapping, evaluation window and variant definitions

checkpoint_gate.rule: Every checkpoint must be restored and match its recorded SHA-256 before preprocessing output is used for inference. An arm with any missing or mismatching checkpoint is dropped and recorded before inference; no arm may be dropped after inference.

inference.zero_shot_ensemble: softmax per fold, float64 arithmetic mean over ten folds, argmax, lowest-index tie-break (identical to configs/shhs_zero_shot_v1.json)
inference.adast_ensemble: identical to runs/teacher_revision_gpu_20261007/adast_fullsource_local/final/execution_specification.json; full-record inference then the v1 scoring mask

metrics.macro_f1_definition: five fixed classes; class F1 = 0 when its denominator is zero (identical to v1)
metrics.sensitivity: subject_mean_macro_f1 over classes present in the subject's reference labels; the number of subjects with an absent class is reported

statistics.uncertainty_scope: conditional on fitted checkpoints; does not include training variability

H3.interpretation: band-pass effect: clipping is inactive and division by 100 is absorbed by the stem BatchNorm

confirmatory_family.confirmation_rule: Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 AND bootstrap 95% CI entirely on the expected side of zero

S2_null_pair_and_run_to_run_reference.prespecified_expectation: E4-E3 is not systematically larger in magnitude than same-configuration differences between seeds; E4-E3 is not interpreted as a preprocessing effect

secondary.S5_metric_sensitivity: repeat H1-H3 with the present-class macro-F1
secondary.S6_e6_input_scale: label-free per-record standard deviation of filtered_zscore_v2 inputs inside the evaluation window, summarised as median and IQR and compared descriptively with Sleep-EDF (median 0.77)
secondary.S7_pooled_with_v1: descriptive only: H1-H3 on v1 test (180) plus holdout (500); never used for confirmation

claim_boundary.allowed: confirmation or non-confirmation of H1-H3 on an untouched SHHS1 sample under the locked v1 pipeline
forbidden: adding or removing confirmatory contrasts after inference
selecting folds, checkpoints or seeds after viewing holdout scores
using holdout labels for any model, threshold, calibration or adaptation choice
equivalence or non-inferiority claims without a pre-specified margin
presenting the pooled 680-subject analysis as confirmatory
